scientific_integrity: Exact Green recurrences and factorizations were checked symbolically and independent finite cyclic Gram inversions checked numerically. Infinite convergence and strict positivity follow from the written analytic argument; no independent review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The main inequalities are explicit lower witnesses for the limiting endpoint norm, not a determination of its exact value or all maximizing evaluations. Even numbers of periodic cells and fixed positive defect ratio are required. No claim for higher-order splines, odd cell counts, or varying defect ratios.
title: A single exceptional cell forces endpoint amplification in periodic linear-spline projection
